title: Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Incentive Settlement Conditions for Late Enrollment Bonuses
content:
**Condition 4.** The enrollment-bonus lateness of a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement — the number of whole calendar months from its approval date to the date the enrollment bonus is credited — decides how the bonus with allowances is credited:

- **(a) 9 months or later:** the bonus with allowances is multiplied by 1.25 and rounded up to the next long-late step of 100 points.
- **(b) 6 months or later, but before 9 months:** it is multiplied by 1.1 and rounded down to the next lower late step of 50 points.
- **(c) Earlier than 6 months:** it is credited as it stands.

"Rounded up to the next step of 100" means raised to the nearest multiple of 100 at or above the figure; "rounded down to the next lower step of 50" means lowered to the nearest multiple of 50 at or below it. A figure already on a multiple stays as it is.

The bonus so settled is the enrollment bonus credited to an agreement whose flown spend since approval has reached the tier's enrollment-bonus spend, on a tier that carries enrollment-bonus points.

### Worked figures (hypothetical bonus with allowances of 3125 points)

| Lateness | Computation | Credited |
|---|---|---|
| 10 months | 3125 multiplied by 1.25 is 3906.25, rounded up to a multiple of 100 | 4000 |
| 9 months | same | 4000 |
| 8 months | 3125 multiplied by 1.1 is 3437.5, rounded down to a multiple of 50 | 3400 |
| 6 months | same | 3400 |
| 5 months | as it stands | 3125 |
